title: [MAIN] Fix undo of final subcontracting operation after earlier operation undo (Bug 653934)
summary: Fixed a bug where undoing the final subcontracting operation on a posted purchase receipt failed with an "Applies-to Entry must have a value" error when an earlier operation had already been undone. The capacity ledger entry lookup is now scoped to the receipt line's routing details and excludes reversal entries.
key_points: Capacity ledger entry lookup now filters by receipt line's Routing No., Routing Reference No., and Operation No. to find the correct entry
Reversal entries are excluded from the lookup to prevent selecting the wrong register after an earlier undo
Output item ledger entries are only collected when the original capacity entry is the last output operation
Undoing intermediate operations now reverses only their capacity using their own time values
New test cases added to verify correct undo behavior for multiple subcontracting operations on the same receipt
